jobs.description:
About This Role

Hi, Denise here and I am the Head of Mid-Market Customer Success at Ashby 👋. Our team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional high-touch customer experience across the mid-market segment. As we continue expanding we are thrilled to be hiring our next CSM in EMEA to help shape how we serve customers in this region, ranging from high growth start ups to public companies.

As a member of our Customer Success team, you will help us continue to grow our High Touch Mid-Market Customer Success function. In this role, you'll implement, train, and support the adoption of Ashby with customers across the region, partnering closely with a talented group of four CSMs on the EMEA Mid-Market team.

Ashby is designed to be powerful and flexible, allowing users to adjust it to their needs. This means that there is a lot to learn. You will become a product and domain expert in order to enable our customers to make the best use of Ashby to drive hiring excellence.

Role Requirements

You have a strong track record of customer success experience in B2B SaaS (at least two years), supporting the implementation and adoption of complex technologies. In this role, you will manage four to eight week implementations, while continuing to deliver value through the customer journey.
You’re experienced managing a book of ~60 mid-market customers, exceeding $1.5M in total ARR. You enjoy developing relationships across a broad set of stakeholders while supporting existing teams to drive adoption and retention
You have experience working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.
You love becoming a product and industry expert and have experience doing this in a previous customer success role. You can create ‘Ah ha!’ moments by tailoring training and product walk throughs to address a customer’s specific challenges.
You’ve worked with technically complex products and show a strong curiosity to explore details and understand how things work.

You Should Apply If

📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms. You avoid business jargon.
🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as providing the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our product roadmap delivers value.
📊You enjoy working with a larger book of varied customers, and can effectively prioritise your time to make the biggest impact.
🧩 You’re energised by learning and supporting a complex product. You enjoy diving deep into technical details, navigating advanced configurations, and data workflows, and you enjoy helping customers make sense of them.
🧑‍🏫 You love to teach. Whether it’s a complex report to a very tenured data analyst, or a workflow to a brand new recruiter, who is new to SaaS tools, you see every teaching moment as an opportunity.
⚙️ You are not only excited about driving renewals, but also crafting repeatable processes that will allow our go-to-market team to scale well in future.
🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.
⚡️ You move fast. You leverage tools/technology to maximize your time. You are at home managing a wide range of customers, and prioritizing effectively.
🗺️ You're energized by an ever-improving work environment. Our team is growing, and continually iterating on processes - we live by our Operating Principle of "Implement Continuous Improvement"
📊 You are always looking for ways to improve your work through data.
👨‍👨‍👧‍👧 You have been a recruiter, hiring manager or interviewer in a previous role. Recruiting experience paired with SaaS CSMing helps to make the onboarding process quicker, and can help you serve as a trusted advisor to our customers. Not a requirement though!

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

If you tend to thrive with a smaller, more focused book of customers, this role likely isn’t the right fit. Our Mid-Market CSMs typically manage a book of 60+ customers, balancing personalized relationships with efficient, scalable support.
You're interested in managing customer accounts with infrequent and well-defined touchpoints (rather than excited by the fluidity required of early stage CS work)
You shine as an exclusively commercial CSM, motivated by variable compensation. While our team's north star metric is revenue retention, we focus on adoption and engagement as our leading indicators. For renewal negotiation and upsell, we have a lovely team of Contract Managers. As such, this role does not currently include variable pay, aligning with our strategy to hire product-oriented CSMs rather than adhering to the conventional Account Manager model.
You’re afraid of rolling up your sleeves. If the idea of getting in the weeds with a customer about the nuance between a time in process report and a time to hire report feels too granular, or project managing a workflow change for offer approvals feels “beneath you”, this job isn’t going to be for you.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/

We are well-funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We publicly launched in October 2022 and are already working with thousands of amazing companies, including Opendoor, Plaid, Airtable, Snyk, Benchling and SalesLoft.

We’ve built an incredible team and exceptional product over the past couple of years, and we truly are just getting started. In short, this is the perfect time to join 🚀

Interview Process

Role

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

Intro Call with Ashby Recruiting - 30 Minutes
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 Minutes
Take-Home/Presentation Interview - 45 Minutes
Panel Interview - 2 hours
Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into a series of smaller conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting focused on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, how you work with sales, and dive into a product complexity exercise.

Benefits

You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Agiloft is the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Agiloft, you will manage a portfolio of high-value and strategically important customers with complex business needs, stakeholder environments, and service engagements.
You will serve as a trusted advisor, developing a deep understanding of customer objectives and helping customers maximize the value they realize from Agiloft. Through proactive, data-informed account management, you will guide adoption, monitor customer health, identify risks, and shape strategies that support retention, growth, and long-term success. You will bring strong product expertise and consultative skills to help customers understand relevant capabilities, navigate configurations, and adopt functionality that supports their business priorities. You will partner closely with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to coordinate complex customer engagements, address challenges, and identify expansion opportunities.
Success in this role looks like strong strategic customer relationships, measurable value realization, sustained adoption and retention, effective navigation of complex stakeholder environments, and identification of meaningful opportunities to expand customer value.

Job Responsibilities

Strategic Customer Partnership & Value Realization
Serve as the primary Customer Success partner for a portfolio of high-value and strategically important customers.
Build trusted relationships across complex customer organizations, including senior and executive stakeholders as appropriate.
Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives, priorities, success measures, and evolving needs.
Translate customer goals into clear success plans and measurable outcomes supported by Agiloft.
Conduct strategic customer engagements and Business Reviews to assess progress, demonstrate value, and align on priorities.
Act as a trusted advisor by recommending approaches that help customers maximize the value of Agiloft.

Product Expertise, Adoption & Customer Health
Maintain strong product expertise and advise customers on relevant Agiloft capabilities, new functionality, and best practices.
Conduct product demonstrations as appropriate and provide consultative guidance on technical setups and configurations within the scope of the role.
Guide feature adoption, onboarding, and change management for key capabilities and customer initiatives.
Monitor usage, engagement, account health, and other customer signals to identify potential risks and opportunities.
Develop and execute strategies to improve adoption, address customer challenges, and strengthen value realization.
Use data and customer insights to inform account strategy, recommendations, and customer conversations.

Retention, Growth & Account Strategy
Proactively manage customer health and risk to support strong retention across the assigned portfolio.
Partner with Account Managers on renewal and growth strategy, providing customer context, health insights, risks, and value realization information.
Identify and qualify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities based on customer objectives, adoption, and evolving needs.
Generate internal referrals and contribute to pipeline growth through strategic identification of customer opportunities.
Maintain accurate account information, risks, opportunities, and customer activity within relevant systems.

Complex Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Coordinate across Implementation, Support, Sales, Product, Engineering, partner implementers, and other internal stakeholders to advance complex customer needs and service engagements.
Navigate competing customer priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder interests to maintain progress and alignment.
Communicate complex customer needs, risks, and opportunities clearly across internal and external stakeholder groups.
Represent the voice of the customer internally and contribute insights that can inform product, process, and customer experience improvements.
Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, synthesize customer and account information, and streamline routine Customer Success workflows.
Apply sound judgment when balancing customer needs, business objectives, available resources, and competing priorities.
Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Relationship Management, or a related customer-facing role within a SaaS or technology environment.
Experience managing high-value, complex, or strategically important customer relationships.
Experience supporting complex service engagements and working across multiple customer stakeholders, priorities, or use cases.
Proven experience building and maintaining trusted customer relationships while driving adoption, retention, value realization, and growth.
Strong product and technical acumen with the ability to conduct product demonstrations and provide consultative guidance on product configurations.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at varying levels of seniority, including senior and executive stakeholders as appropriate.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex customer needs, risks, and opportunities and determine appropriate strategies.
Ability to use data, customer insights, and business context to inform account strategy and recommendations.
Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to independently manage multiple complex customer relationships and competing objectives.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence across functions to drive customer outcomes.
Adaptability and comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote environment.
Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or other advanced systems to support productivity and day-to-day work.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.

Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity.

📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms. You avoid business jargon.

🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.

You're interested in managing customer accounts with infrequent and well-defined touchpoints (rather than excited by the fluidity required of early stage CS work)

For renewal negotiation and upsell, we have a lovely team of Contract Managers. As such, this role does not currently include variable pay, aligning with our strategy to hire product-oriented CSMs rather than adhering to the conventional Account Manager model.
You’re afraid of rolling up your sleeves. About This Role

Hi, Denise here and I am the Head of Mid-Market Customer Success at Ashby 👋. Our team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional high-touch customer experience across the mid-market segment. As we continue expanding we are thrilled to be hiring our next CSM in EMEA to help shape how we serve customers in this region, ranging from high growth start ups to public companies.

As a member of our Customer Success team, you will help us continue to grow our High Touch Mid-Market Customer Success function. In this role, you'll implement, train, and support the adoption of Ashby with customers across the region, partnering closely with a talented group of four CSMs on the EMEA Mid-Market team.

Ashby is designed to be powerful and flexible, allowing users to adjust it to their needs. This means that there is a lot to learn. You will become a product and domain expert in order to enable our customers to make the best use of Ashby to drive hiring excellence.

Role Requirements

You have a strong track record of customer success experience in B2B SaaS (at least two years), supporting the implementation and adoption of complex technologies. In this role, you will manage four to eight week implementations, while continuing to deliver value through the customer journey.
You’re experienced managing a book of ~60 mid-market customers, exceeding $1.5M in total ARR. You enjoy developing relationships across a broad set of stakeholders while supporting existing teams to drive adoption and retention
You have experience working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.
You love becoming a product and industry expert and have experience doing this in a previous customer success role. You can create ‘Ah ha!’ moments by tailoring training and product walk throughs to address a customer’s specific challenges.
You’ve worked with technically complex products and show a strong curiosity to explore details and understand how things work.

You Should Apply If

📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms. You avoid business jargon.
🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as providing the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our product roadmap delivers value.
📊You enjoy working with a larger book of varied customers, and can effectively prioritise your time to make the biggest impact.
🧩 You’re energised by learning and supporting a complex product. You enjoy diving deep into technical details, navigating advanced configurations, and data workflows, and you enjoy helping customers make sense of them.
🧑‍🏫 You love to teach. Whether it’s a complex report to a very tenured data analyst, or a workflow to a brand new recruiter, who is new to SaaS tools, you see every teaching moment as an opportunity.
⚙️ You are not only excited about driving renewals, but also crafting repeatable processes that will allow our go-to-market team to scale well in future.
🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.
⚡️ You move fast. You leverage tools/technology to maximize your time. You are at home managing a wide range of customers, and prioritizing effectively.
🗺️ You're energized by an ever-improving work environment. Our team is growing, and continually iterating on processes - we live by our Operating Principle of "Implement Continuous Improvement"
📊 You are always looking for ways to improve your work through data.
👨‍👨‍👧‍👧 You have been a recruiter, hiring manager or interviewer in a previous role. Recruiting experience paired with SaaS CSMing helps to make the onboarding process quicker, and can help you serve as a trusted advisor to our customers. Not a requirement though!

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

If you tend to thrive with a smaller, more focused book of customers, this role likely isn’t the right fit. Our Mid-Market CSMs typically manage a book of 60+ customers, balancing personalized relationships with efficient, scalable support.
You're interested in managing customer accounts with infrequent and well-defined touchpoints (rather than excited by the fluidity required of early stage CS work)
You shine as an exclusively commercial CSM, motivated by variable compensation. While our team's north star metric is revenue retention, we focus on adoption and engagement as our leading indicators. For renewal negotiation and upsell, we have a lovely team of Contract Managers. As such, this role does not currently include variable pay, aligning with our strategy to hire product-oriented CSMs rather than adhering to the conventional Account Manager model.
You’re afraid of rolling up your sleeves. If the idea of getting in the weeds with a customer about the nuance between a time in process report and a time to hire report feels too granular, or project managing a workflow change for offer approvals feels “beneath you”, this job isn’t going to be for you.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/

We are well-funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We publicly launched in October 2022 and are already working with thousands of amazing companies, including Opendoor, Plaid, Airtable, Snyk, Benchling and SalesLoft.

We’ve built an incredible team and exceptional product over the past couple of years, and we truly are just getting started. In short, this is the perfect time to join 🚀

Interview Process

Role

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

Intro Call with Ashby Recruiting - 30 Minutes
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 Minutes
Take-Home/Presentation Interview - 45 Minutes
Panel Interview - 2 hours
Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into a series of smaller conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting focused on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, how you work with sales, and dive into a product complexity exercise.

Benefits

You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Inside the Role

The Vendor Scheduler is accountable for ensuring the on-time delivery of purchased components required to support production and distribution operations. This role manages supplier schedules through EDI and manual scheduling processes, balances material availability with inventory targets, and helps minimize premium freight. The position supports the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments while using data and analysis to identify supply risks, resolve delivery issues, and improve supply chain performance.

Posting Information

We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected.

We Take Care of Our Team

Position offers a starting salary range of $65,000.00 - $83,000.00 USD

Pay Offered Dependent On Knowledge, Skills, And experience  

Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans. 

What You Drive At DTNA

Manage supplier schedules and ensure purchased components are available in the required quantities and at the required time to support operational demand.
Analyze and adjust ERP parameters to meet production needs based on fluctuating customer demand, lead time and other factors.
Execute and maintain EDI and manual scheduling processes, verifying that schedule requirements are accurate, timely, and clearly communicated.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and material availability; identify shortages, late deliveries, and other risks that could affect operations.
Coordinate material flow in support of the Consolidation Center, parts distribution, and internal Machining departments.
Manage domestic/international supply base for relevant aggregates
Balance component availability with inventory-value objectives and premium-freight targets, escalating risks and trade-offs as appropriate.
Control on hand inventory for multiple assembly plants in US and Mexico
Assemble and analyze supply chain data to evaluate performance, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
Develop and implement practical short-term containment actions and longer-term solutions within defined policies, procedures, and business requirements.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve delivery issues, communicate priorities, and maintain alignment on recovery actions.
Maintain clear documentation of supply issues, decisions, recovery plans, and follow-up actions to support execution and accountability.
Analyze material flow processes seeking opportunities for improvement based on lean/six sigma concepts
Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen scheduling, inventory, delivery, and issue-resolution processes.

Knowledge You Should Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Logistics, Business, or a related field and 0-2 years of relevant experience, is required.
Working knowledge of supply chain planning, material scheduling, inventory management, and supplier delivery concepts.
Ability to use analytical and quantitative methods to interpret data, assess performance, and support sound decisions.
Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and develop effective short-term and long-term actions.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across suppliers and internal teams.
Ability to prioritize multiple requirements, exercise judgment within established procedures, and respond effectively to changing conditions.
An attached resume is required.

Exceptional Candidates Might Have

One to two years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, material scheduling, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, or a related environment.
Experience supporting supplier performance, component availability, production operations, or distribution activities.
Experience working with EDI-enabled and manual scheduling processes.

Where We Work

This position is open to applicants who can work in (or relocate to) the following location(s)-

Detroit, MI US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Schedule Type:

Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration.

At Daimler Truck North America, we recognize our world is changing faster than ever before. By listening to the needs of today, we’re building to solve with cutting-edge solutions in sustainability and future driving technology across electric, hydrogen and autonomous. These solutions, backed by years of innovative success and achievement, continue DTNA’s legacy as the undisputed industry leader. Our evolving brand portfolio is second to none, including Freightliner Trucks, Western Star, Demand Detroit, Thomas Built Buses, Freightliner Custom Chassis, and Financial Services. Together, we work as one team towards our envisioned future – building a cleaner, safer and more efficient tomorrow for all.

That is what we are working toward - for all who keep the world moving.

Department

Network Planning

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description

Job Summary

Ready to help shape where Southwest flies and how we serve our Customers? As a Network Planning Analyst, you will support the planning and optimization of Southwest’s flight schedules and network capacity, helping ensure the right service is offered in the right markets at the right time. You will analyze performance data, identify business insights, develop recommendations, and communicate trends that support network planning decisions. In this role, you will collaborate with internal Commercial Teams and external airport partners, contribute to strategic planning initiatives, and help implement schedule and capacity changes that drive operational and financial performance. Your work will directly influence Southwest’s network strategy, strengthen key partnerships, and support the reliable service our Customers depend on.

Additional Details

The culture of Southwest Airlines means we value the camaraderie, collaboration, and innovation that occurs when we come together and interact face-to-face at our vibrant Corporate Campus. Due to the nature of this role, you would be required to work from our Dallas, TX headquarters facility during business hours.   
U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Responsibilities

Utilize the flight scheduling software at an intermediate level to be able to add, delete, change equipment, and adjust flights to produce the best schedule possible
Assists with complex, highly visible flight schedule revisions
Monitor a checklist to create zero-defect flight schedules
Utilize various scheduling techniques to clear violations of operational constraints while minimizing impact to commercial timings
Identify complex schedule changes and how to apply these in the schedule software
Analyze impact of changes to operational and commercial constraints in the schedule
Understand the impact changes to the schedule have on the system and Customer
Identify opportunities to increase revenue and reduce costs in the schedule
Create the individual week schedules in preparation for schedule publication
Utilize the flight scheduling software to be able to finalize and create files for distribution
Utilize Amadeus products to check flight loads and validate schedules
Assist with complex, highly visible flight schedule reporting
Apply knowledge and skills of analysis, business processes, tools, domains, project methodologies, requirements definitions, and testing to solve a range of problems
Develop standard reports by building queries to pull and organize data from various sources, establishing the frequency, and validating the necessity of the report based upon the needs of the organization
Identify problems, performs root cause analysis, investigates information, performs impact analysis, and formulates and executes plans to develop solutions
Create and presents data analytics, both written and oral, to Manager
Provide routine and ad hoc reporting regarding flight schedule revisions to Team
Communicate business insights and analysis regarding flight schedule revisions
Deliver timely, zero-defect data analysis
May perform other job duties as directed by Employee’s Leaders

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Ability to work well with others as part of a Team
Ability to execute a high level of attention to detail
Ability to partner with Technology and other work groups to enhance data quality and accessibility
Ability to transform raw data into easily understood, presentable and actionable findings
Ability to answer business questions using experience, logical reasoning and analytical skills
Ability to handle multiple concurrent projects and prioritize accordingly
Ability and desire to take ownership of individual and Team deliverables

Education

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Experience

Intermediate level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in:
Airline network planning including flight schedule alignment with commercial and operational impact, industry-leading capabilities, and aircraft scheduling techniques; or related experience
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft Office suite
Written and verbal communication
Handling multiple concurrent projects and prioritizing accordingly

Preferred: Experience using Tableau for data analysis and visualization.
Preferred: Experience using PowerPoint to develop presentations and communicate information.
Preferred: Experience using Diio Mi for airline network planning, scheduling, or related analysis.

Licensing/Certification

N/A

Physical Abilities

Ability to perform work duties from [limited space work station/desk/office area] for extended periods of time
Ability to communicate and interact with others in the English language to meet the demands of the job
Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed and accuracy to meet the demands of the job

Other Qualifications

Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines
Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
Must be at least 18 years of age
Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines
